Baseline transcript — global Overview / project space, slice 0
docs/plans/active/global-overview-workspaces.md, slice 0 item 3

Recorded before any global-scope work, so a later slice can be compared against
what Sidecar does today. Every capture in this directory is the ANSI-stripped
pane text of a real Sidecar process driven headlessly, with trailing spaces
removed. isolated-paths.txt records the roots the run used; both isolation axes
were private (tmux server under the run dir via TMUX_TMPDIR, state/config under
the run dir with SIDECAR_ISOLATED_STATE=1). The machine's default tmux server
was never touched.

How to reproduce
----------------
  go build -o /tmp/sidecar-slice0/sidecar ./cmd/sidecar
  export SIDECAR_DRIVE_RUN_DIR=/tmp/sidecar-drive-slice0-$(id -u)
  export SIDECAR_BIN=/tmp/sidecar-slice0/sidecar
  ./scripts/tmux-drive.sh paths          # confirm both axes are isolated first
  ./scripts/tmux-drive.sh start 200 50
  ...steps below...
  ./scripts/tmux-drive.sh stop

The isolated config had no configured projects, so the Agents board is honestly
empty. That is deliberate for this recording: what is being characterized is app
chrome, scope naming, tab routing and exact return, not board content — board
content already has dense coverage in internal/overview.

Wide transcript (200x50)
------------------------
  start 200 50                -> wide-project-startup.txt
      Project space. Title "Sidecar / sidecar [global-workspace]"; project
      plugin tabs td/git/files/workspaces; td plugin active.
  keys K                      -> wide-global-agents.txt
      Global space. Title becomes "Sidecar / Overview" and the content is the
      Agent Overview board — but the header still shows the PROJECT plugin tab
      row, with no tab marked active. This is the exact ambiguity slice 1
      replaces with [Agents] [Workspaces] [Tasks].
  keys q                      -> (not captured; returns to td)
  keys 4                      -> wide-project-workspaces.txt
      A number key routes to a project plugin. From the global space it would
      also have left it; today numeric keys and ` [ ] ~ are project-plugin
      navigation whatever the space.
  keys j                      -> wide-project-workspaces-after-j.txt
      Sidebar navigation moves the selection shell-first through shells then
      worktrees and the preview follows it.
  keys K                      -> wide-global-agents-reentry.txt
      Re-entering the global space from Workspaces; the project underneath is
      untouched.
  keys q                      -> wide-project-restored.txt
      Exact return: the Workspaces plugin, its sidebar and its preview come back
      as they were, with no project reinitialization.

Narrow transcript (72x30)
-------------------------
  start 72 30                 -> narrow-project-startup.txt
  keys 4                      -> narrow-project-workspaces.txt
      Header truncation drops inactive tabs from the right (files is gone) while
      keeping the destination title and the active plugin tab; the two-pane
      split still renders both panes at this width.
  keys K                      -> narrow-global-agents.txt
      Compact Overview keeps the app header and footer, and the project tab row
      is still what the header shows in the global space.
